nome_en: Saint Gachi Maria, Channeler of Suns
nome_jp: 光器セイント・ガチ・マリア
testo: ■ At the start of your turn, you and your opponent may play Power Gachinko Judge. If you win, put the top card of your deck into your shields. (Power Gachinko Judge: Each player reveals the top card of their deck and puts it on the bottom. You win if your card has the same or more power than your opponent's. Cards that have no power are treated as having 0 power.)
testo_jp: ■ 自分のターンのはじめに、相手とパワー・ガチンコ・ジャッジしてもよい。自分が勝ったら、自分の山札の上から1枚をシールド化する。
